status: Expanded tournament-team development evaluation complete; final events remain untouched

team_source.name: VGCPastes Champions M-C catalog, distributed through MunchStats
team_source.attribution: Team data from the VGCPastes Repository; fetched via MunchStats' public teams-data branch.
team_source.filter: Top 256 or better, six distinct complete sets, exact published SP spreads only
team_source.legal_validation: 136 of 136 normalized teams (70 development, 66 reserved final) passed local Showdown format validation.
team_source.redistribution_note: Raw source is cached locally for reproducibility and attribution. No separate redistribution license was identified; do not redistribute cached teams.

split.method: Event holdout; development and final use separate tournament events and have no exact roster overlap.

evaluation.design: 35 fixed development team-pair clusters, four outcome repeats per pair, both seat orders, same team pairs, seeds, and Round402 learned preview selector for all arms.
evaluation.opponent: Max Damage baseline; full information-boundary certification remains open

round430_ppo.information_boundary: policy player-view path; full audit pending

evaluation.interpretation: Both agents scored below 50% against Max Damage. Public Counterplay's point estimate is 9.3 percentage points higher, but the paired team-cluster interval crosses zero. Current evidence does not establish a reliable difference or robust winning play; use development results for diagnosis only. The reserved events were not evaluated.
evaluation.fault_found_and_fixed: The initial top-64 screen exposed a poke-env KeyError for custom-format move entries with no optional priority field. Missing priority now follows Showdown's default of zero; all 280-match reruns completed with no failures.

speed.measurement_note: End-to-end evaluation throughput; the PPO policy is about 21% slower than this baseline in this run. No component-level profile was collected.
